usage: tunnel ssl [-h] [--base BASE] [--json] {ls,add,rm,on,off,exclude} ...

positional arguments:
  {ls,add,rm,on,off,exclude}
    ls                  show both lists and the switch
    add                 decrypt these hosts
    rm                  stop decrypting these hosts
    on                  decrypt the included hosts again
    off                 tunnel every HTTPS connection through undecrypted
    exclude             hosts never to decrypt, whatever the include list says

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --base BASE           where the admin API answers (default
                        http://127.0.0.1:8000)
  --json                print raw JSON, errors included, for piping into jq
